notes.title: Toymaker is on Steam!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
We are really happy to anounce that the Steam page for Toymaker is live!

[previewyoutube=Yc28WXg3CVg;full][/previewyoutube]

You can wishlist the game here: Steam Page

WHAT IS TOYMAKER 
Toymaker is a crafting game with an interesting story, set in the 1910s in Spain, based on a folk story. 
The player has to create cute plushies and sell them in their shop, inherited when their mom disappeared. 


We hope you like the game and if you do... add it to your wishlist! And leave us a comment if you want :)

Love,
Celer
